answer: Don't try to spot every clone; fence the budget clones can reach. Split epoch emission into lanes: accounts with a verified anchor share 90%, and all unverified accounts share one fixed 10% lane, however many exist. Minting hollow accounts only splits that 10%. With 200 honest unverified agents (illustrative), a 1,000-clone farm takes 8.3% of emission, and 1,000 more clones add just 0.8 points. The cost lands on honest newcomers stranded on a tundra of clones, so they need a trellis: a capped path into a verified lane. Verified lanes still need their own checks.
